occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Observed 2 infants without an updated infant feeding instructions.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Observed the playground areas without the proper amount of loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have a current driver transportation certificate available for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unsupervised on the playground for approximately 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several tree branches are hanging over the playground equipment. The branches are low enough where they are in the children faces as they play on the play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There were brown spots on the ceilings in the infant room. I observed cracked tiles and dips  in the floorings in the Prek room flooring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The nap mats were not properly label in the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver slammed a door closed that led to a child in care getting their finger caught between the door, resulting in the child's finger being broken. A caregiver submitted a falsified incident report about what actually happened regarding the child's broken finger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The last fire inspection was conducted on 7/18/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that children are being forced to sleep by holding their heads down to the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the director is aware of the caregivers not complying with standards and not addressing the issue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Exceeding Maximum Group Size -Ratio Meet: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that classrooms are going out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size -Ratio Meet (26 TAC §746.1611(b))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Two emergency medications observed was not in the original packaging.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose fill on the playground depth was not properly maintained.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two out of four children files reviewed did not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: 2 baby bottles were not labeled during the follow up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: FA kit was still missing the following: FA guide, scissors, thermometer, tweezers, and adhesive tape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 1 child record with known food allergy still did not have a food allergy emergency plan available to during follow up
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: Director was not able to provide a monthly checklist with dates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 3 out of 8 caregivers records did not  the following available to review: proof of education, affidavit and orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 4 out of 8 children's record did not contain complete admission information. occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 1 out of 8 children did not have a current immunization record.

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: A 6 inch metal bar was protruding at the bottom of playground equipment. There is no protective barrier around the protruding bar.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There was dead roaches throughout the operation that have not been properly disposed of.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: FA kit was missing the following: FA guide, antiseptic wipes, scissors, thermometer, tweezers, and adhesive tape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 1 child record with known food allergy did not have a food allergy emergency plan available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: 5 baby bottles was not labeled with child's first name and last initial in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months: 1 out of 5 employees files evaluated did not have pre service training of understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Nap cots were not properly labeled in multiple classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills was missing for months January 2023 and February 2023. Exit time for March 2023 fire drill exceeded the 3 minutes limit by 2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed not washing their hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver stated there were 19 children in care and when counting the number of children there were 20 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: Based on the information obtained, caregivers did not set appropriate behavior expectations for school-age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: There was no written activity schedule posted for the school age children. The caregiver was not following the activity schedule.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained a caregiver failed to practice good judgment by loading the daycare bus that is designed to seat 14 children with 15 children while transporting to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support that a child was not secured in a passenger safety seat system due to the daycare bus being overloaded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5607(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support the seat belts in the buses do not secure and are not in safe operating condition.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the number of children in their group during the inspection. The caregiver stated there were 19 children. After counting there were 15 children outside on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two ant beds were observed on the playground which are accessible to the children play area
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Upon arrival to the operation, 9  school age children were observed lined up at the door unsupervised while the caregiver was inside the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.307(d))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: Based on the information obtained, the operation did not notify CCR when they became aware that a child enrolled at the facility contracted COVID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: The dead insects have not been disposed of.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to notify licensing after allowing a child to wander away from the caregiver unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A child was left alone inside a classroom while the caregiver was on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: A child's parent was not told the truth about a situation that placed their child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At a follow up inspection the operation still does not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver gave an infant another child's bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

When asked why the 2 children were in restrictive devices, the caregiver stated the children bite and fight the other chldren. Prohibited punishment was discussed with the caregiver and acting director and the children were removed from the restrictive devices.
